blocks.text: Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026

This bill requires the Office of Veterans Business Development within the Small Business Administration (SBA) to develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with existing reporting requirements related to veteran-owned small businesses. Specifically, such policies must ensure the SBA complies and submits an annual report on the needs of small businesses owned and controlled by veterans, including service-disabled veterans. Such reports must also include proposals to improve the access of such businesses to government assistance.

This bill requires the Office of Veterans Business Development at the Small Business Administration (SBA) to create and carry out rules and procedures that make sure the SBA follows its existing reporting requirements for veteran-owned small businesses. Under these rules, the SBA must submit a yearly report on what small businesses owned and controlled by veterans, including service-disabled veterans, need. Each report must also include suggestions for how these businesses can get better access to government assistance.
